ITEM 1 | Pale salmon-colored fillet-like piece, flaky and moist-looking with light tan crust edges and a speckled herb/pepper coating on top, sitting at upper center of plate, roughly 12 x 8 cm footprint and about 2.5 cm thick, holds shape with flakes at edges | 230
ITEM 2 | Dark green curly leafy vegetable with ruffled edges and crisp-looking texture, lightly dressed with fine pale flecks, spread across lower right of plate, about 12 x 7 cm, piled about 2 cm high | 85
ITEM 3 | Bright green arugula-type leafy greens with thin stems and small pale leaves, lightly dressed and glossy, covering left half of plate, about 15 x 10 cm, piled about 2 cm high | 70
ITEM 4 | Small roasted Brussels sprouts halves and whole pieces, bright green with browned, charred outer leaves and slightly glossy sheen, clustered at right of center, about 7 x 6 cm, about 2 cm high | 60
ITEM 5 | Whole dark blueberries, glossy deep purple-black, scattered among the greens, each about 1 cm diameter, about 6 berries | 12
ITEM 6 | Single whole strawberry, bright red with green calyx and seedy surface, sitting among the greens near center-left, about 3 x 2.5 cm | 12
ITEM 7 | Thin pale shaved flakes, off-white and slightly translucent, scattered over the greens and kale, small pieces about 1 cm, dry-looking | 5
ITEM 8 | Light dressing or oil sheen, glistening on the greens and fillet surface, thin film with no pooling visible | 5
